content: jw1912/bullet (Rust, crate bullet_lib) is the SOTA NNUE trainer used by most top engines. Backends via feature flags: cuda (NVIDIA, primary/most-tuned), rocm (AMD HIP), and metal (Apple Silicon + Intel Mac). So a Metal path now EXISTS, but it is newer/less battle-tested, Rust not Python, and the community's tuning+docs are CUDA-centric; M4 neural throughput trails NVIDIA. For a Python-first, understandable, swappable-eval M1 milestone, prefer nnue-pytorch-style PyTorch MPS training over adopting bullet.
